professionalSummary.text: Plans and controls capital equipment projects with a baseline schedule and cost tracking.
professionalSummary.witness: planned the replacement of a yoghurt cup filler and a case erector, keeping the baseline schedule in MS Project and tracking committed and actual cost against the approved budget.

experienceHighlights.text: Manages equipment suppliers and installation contractors, including contract change requests.
experienceHighlights.witness: Managed the filler supplier and two installation contractors during a three-week shutdown, logging each contract change request with its cost and the plant engineering manager's approval.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Runs site acceptance tests with production and quality teams.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Wrote the site acceptance test protocol for the new filler with the production and quality leads and recorded each test result and deviation until the line was released back to production.

skills.text: Reports cost and schedule to a capital board or equivalent governance forum.
skills.witness: Prepared the monthly cost and schedule report for the site capital review, showing committed spend, forecast to complete and milestone status for each open project.
